concepts.name: Neon Express
concepts.design: A confident front-view city bus. Broad cyan squared body, one bold black windshield, two lime square headlights, two short white wheels. Crisp slightly chamfered upper corners. Strong recognizable bus silhouette with no tiny details. This is the recommended, most instantly readable design.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: one launcher icon concept for KasugaBus, an interactive Japanese bus timetable app on Pebble Time 2.
Primary request: Option 01 "Neon Express".
Subject: A confident front-view city bus. Broad white squared body, one bold black windshield, two white square headlights, two short white wheels. Crisp slightly chamfered upper corners. Strong recognizable bus silhouette with no tiny details. This is the recommended, most instantly readable design.
Style/medium: exceptionally clean, bold, professional minimal pixel-grid glyph, designed to be manually finalized on a 25 by 25 pixel grid. Flat pure white silhouette and pure black negative space only. Every element chunky and legible. No antialiasing aesthetic, no gradients, no glow, no texture, no shadows, no 3D.
Composition: ONE icon, centered and square, occupying 70 percent of a plain black square canvas with a generous black margin. No rounded-square app tile frame. Crisp hard pixel edges aligned to one consistent coarse square grid. The preview is enlarged, not a photo of a watch.
Constraints: total visual silhouette should plausibly fit a 25 by 25 pixel grid with at least 2-pixel-wide primary strokes. Never small extra pictograms, thin lines, fine detail, misleading route numbers, or existing transit-company branding. No text, no title, no labels, no watermark. Letter K allowed only if the specified concept includes K.
Output intent: individual visual option 1 for a later numbered comparison gallery. Keep this graphic bold and instantly recognizable at tiny size.
